csv_project_name: PPP for Various Municipal Facility and Infrastructure Impr
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Ligonier, Indiana, pursuant to Indiana Code 5-23 and the City s adopted public-private agreement procedures, is requesting Statements of Qualifications ( SOQs ) from qualified developer-led BOT/P3 teams for the evaluation, planning, and potential delivery of various municipal facility and infrastructure improvements. Potential projects may include municipal building renovations, former fire station improvements, City Hall improvements, operational support facilities, and park-related improvements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: PPP for Various Municipal Facility and Infrastructure Improvements
short_description: Developer-led PPP for municipal building, facility, and park improvement planning and delivery.
project_scope: Request for qualifications for developer-led BOT/P3 teams to evaluate, plan, and potentially deliver various municipal facility and infrastructure improvements in the City of Ligonier. Potential components include municipal building renovations, former fire station improvements, City Hall improvements, operational support facilities, and park-related improvements. No technical dimensions, floor areas, spans, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Developer-led BOT/P3 services including evaluation, planning, and potential delivery; design-build/developer services; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil, geotechnical, electrical, fire protection, mechanical, and structural engineering; land use planning; master planning; redevelopment planning; and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad municipal PPP/RFQ without a clearly defined structure or building project.
- Scope is dominated by general municipal facilities, renovations, planning, and park-related improvements.
- Includes structural engineering, but also many non-core disciplines and developer-led delivery.
- No indication of long spans, special structures, bridges, stadiums, or architecturally demanding buildings.
- Framework-like multi-project character and strong general planning focus reduce relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice only describes a citywide PPP/RFQ for various potential municipal facility and infrastructure improvements, including renovations and park-related works, without quantities, sizes, or budgets. A realistic estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because the procurement is an early-stage RFQ for a developer-led BOT/P3 team covering multiple possible projects with undefined scope, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified developer-led BOT/P3 teams are requested. Disciplines sought include design-build/developer, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, land use planning, master planning, redevelopment planning, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference counts or project thresholds are stated.
contracting_authority: City of Ligonier, Indiana, USA. Contact: Barb Hawn. Phone: 260-894-4113. Fax: 260-894-3999.
notes: RFQ/SOQ under Indiana Code 5-23 and the City's public-private agreement procedures. Solicitation documents are available by contact. Project is described as time sensitive. Source lists target market as General Building.
